ideas.pitch: A forensic analysis toolkit specifically designed to detect and extract hidden payloads in enterprise images and audio files using LSB analysis and statistical entropy scanning.
ideas.title: StegoGuard Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Steganography domain of the CTF, providing an automated edge for analyzing complex challenge files.

ideas.pitch: An automated Open-Source Intelligence gathering tool that ingests target aliases or handles, scrapes public breadcrumbs, and constructs a visual relationship graph of digital footprints.
ideas.title: OSINT Graph Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence patterns seen in winning AML and security tooling to quickly solve complex OSINT target tracing challenges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted reverse engineering companion that ingests assembly or decompiled C pseudocode and generates plain-language explanations of hidden binary logic and vulnerability hooks.
ideas.title: DecompileLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the grueling Reverse Engineering domain by cutting down manual analysis time through structured code summarization.

ideas.pitch: A modular cryptography cracking utility targeting weak RSA implementations, custom XOR ciphers, and flawed padding oracles commonly found in CTF challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoBreaker CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on genuine hard cryptographic math and automation, saving crucial minutes during a fast-paced live CTF competition.

ideas.pitch: A rapid digital forensics triage tool that parses volatile memory dumps to extract hidden processes, injected DLLs, and suspicious network artifacts.
ideas.title: MemoryDump Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Digital Forensics domain by automating complex volatility plugins into a cohesive, fast-reporting dashboard.
